articles.title: Delhi Woman Found Shot Dead in Baghpat Forest; Husband Confesses to Murder After Hiding First Marr
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tayyaba (25), also known as Taimba, a resident of Dayalpur in northeast Delhi, was allegedly shot dead by her husband, Faisal Chaudhary (34), on November 22, 2025, in a bid to hide his first marriage.

body.html:
Tayyaba (25), also known as Taimba, a resident of Dayalpur in northeast Delhi, was allegedly shot dead by her husband, Faisal Chaudhary (34), on November 22, 2025, in a bid to hide his first marriage. Her body, bearing a gunshot wound to the head, was recovered from the forest area of Sarurpur Kalan village in Baghpat district, Uttar Pradesh, on November 26, after Faisal confessed during police interrogation. She had been reported missing at the Dayalpur police station on November 23 after she failed to return home from work.

According to police, Faisal, a resident of Old Mustafabad, had secretly married Tayyaba in court on April 15, 2025, after meeting her at a club where he introduced himself as single. He was already married and had two children. Tayyaba later insisted that he take her to his home, causing pressure that Faisal allegedly wanted to escape without alerting his first family.

On the day of the murder, Faisal picked her up in a friend’s Hyundai i20, took her to a club where he consumed alcohol, and then shot her inside the car while driving toward Baghpat.

Delhi Police traced him through sightings with Tayyaba, and he surrendered at Karkardooma Court on November 25. He was remanded to police custody for two days, during which he confessed and led the police to the body on November 26. The Hyundai i20 used in the crime was seized. A 17-year-old boy who assisted him was also apprehended. Sections 103(1) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita have been added to the case, and efforts are underway to recover the weapon.

A postmortem was conducted on November 27, after which the body was handed over to the family. Tayyaba, the youngest among her siblings, worked in a private job in Dilshad Garden. Her family learned of the marriage only after Faisal’s confession. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Dumper Crushes Car: 7 of Same Family Killed in Saharanpur Horror Crash #breakingnews
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Saharanpur, Uttar Pradesh: Seven members of the same family, including a child, were killed on the spot after a dumper truck loaded with gravel overturned on their car on the Delhi–Dehradun Expressway on Friday (28 Nov 2025).

body.html:
Saharanpur, Uttar Pradesh: Seven members of the same family, including a child, were killed on the spot after a dumper truck loaded with gravel overturned on their car on the Delhi–Dehradun Expressway on Friday (28 Nov 2025). The accident occurred within the limits of Gagalhedi police station.

According to police and local reports, a family from Sayyid Majra village was travelling in their car when a speeding dumper coming from the Dehradun side lost control and toppled directly onto the vehicle. The gravel in the dumper also collapsed onto the car, crushing it completely.

The impact was so severe that the five-foot-long car was reduced to just two feet. Three cranes were required to lift the overturned dumper, while locals worked for hours to clear the gravel. The victims trapped inside were heard screaming, and rescuers had to cut open the car roof, but all seven had already died.

Eyewitnesses said the dumper driver braked suddenly after the car came in front of the truck, but due to high speed, he failed to control the vehicle, leading to the fatal rollover.

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath expressed deep grief over the tragedy and directed officials to reach the spot immediately and ensure prompt relief measures. He has also ordered proper medical arrangements for the injured, if any.

articles.title: Wife, Lover Arrested in Chilling ‘Love Triangle Murder’ — Sitapur Police Crack Case in 48 Hours!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh — In a shocking breakthrough, police uncovered a sensational plot behind the murder of a young man in Kamalapur area. The victim’s wife and her lover have been arrested for allegedly planning and executing the killing with a sharp weapon.

body.html:
Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh — In a shocking breakthrough, police uncovered a sensational plot behind the murder of a young man in Kamalapur area. The victim’s wife and her lover have been arrested for allegedly planning and executing the killing with a sharp weapon.

According to police, on 25 November around 6 a.m., Manish was on his way to Lakhimpur Kheri to attend his tea shop. His wife Kajal was dropping him to the bus stand on her scooter. Meanwhile, she had already called her lover Ajit and his friend to the Baraikheda turn.

As soon as Manish arrived at the spot, Ajit and the accomplice attacked him with an axe, leaving him critically injured. He was rushed to the Lucknow Trauma Centre, where he died later that night. Kajal initially misled police by refusing to identify the attackers and filing a complaint against unknown persons.

During investigation, police interrogation revealed the truth. Kajal confessed to plotting the murder with her lover. Police recovered the murder weapon, blood-stained clothes, three mobile phones and a scooter. Both accused have been sent to jail.

Kamalapur police and the SOG team solved the blind murder within 48 hours. Police said Kajal had married Manish after the death of his first wife, who was also her elder sister. Despite marriage, Kajal continued her affair with Ajit, leading to frequent disputes at home before the crime was executed.
